scripts.install:api: cd apps/api && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && ([ -f .env ] || cp .env.example .env)
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:api && npm run install:web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
